L113: # Transfer Credits to TESU
L114: ## Transfer Credits to TESU
L115: 
L116:   * 【58†Send Transcripts to TESU】
L117:   * 【59†New Jersey Statewide Transfer & Articulation Agreement Appeals Process】
L118: 
L119: Thomas Edison State University has one of the most flexible transfer credit policies in the country.
L120:   * If you studied at an 【60†accepted institutionally accredited†tesu.smartcatalogiq.com】 community college, you may transfer and apply up to 90 credits.
L121:   * If you studied at an 【60†accepted institutionally accredited†tesu.smartcatalogiq.com】 four-year institution, you may fulfill all your degree requirements with transfer credit except the two required courses from TESU:
L122:     * SOS-1100: Fact, Fiction, or Fake? Information Literacy Today
L123:     * Capstone Course
L124:   * If you have studied at more than one institution, we can accept your credits, provided the institutions have an 【60†accepted institutional accreditation†tesu.smartcatalogiq.com】.
L125: Transfer credit evaluations are conducted only for active applicants. A maximum of 2 evaluations will be completed; there is no limit on the number of transcripts/certifications evaluated at the time of the two evaluation reviews. Evaluations cannot be completed until all required admissions documents have been received and processed. Evaluations cannot be completed on unofficial documents.
L126: Applicants should monitor both their Student Self-Service portal and the email address provided on their application for status updates regarding transcript receipt, admissions requirements, and transfer credit evaluation.

L135: Thomas Edison State University generally accepts the credit recommendations of ACE (American Council on Education) and NCCRS (National College Credit Recommendation Service), however, the University reserves the right to determine the appropriate equivalency and application to a degree program. The University maintains an Approved Provider Directory of approved non-collegiate providers recommended by either ACE or NCCRS.
